description: Source code for initializing and managing memory for an N-Band equalizer module, including functions for memory requirements, initialization, and internal setup.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Memory
methods.description: Calculates memory requirements or provides allocated memory addresses for the equalizer instance based on whether the handle is NULL or not.

methods.name: LVEQNB_Init
methods.description: Creates or re-initializes an equalizer instance, allocating necessary memory and setting default parameters.
